description_citations.text: "Yahenni". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rashmi and Mitul face qualifiers within a week, hoping for the Consulate's support.
timeline.quote: The Inventors' Fair qualifiers were less than a week away.

citation.text: "A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana throws her drink in a Consulate vedalken's face and introduces Chandra as a renegade sympathizer.
timeline.quote: tossing her drink into the vedalken's face

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: When the soldier pulls out restraints, Chandra punches him unconscious.
timeline.quote: Chandra's fist arced around and collided with his jawbone in one fluid motion.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chased by Consulate guards, Chandra refuses Liliana's lethal option and blocks the alley with a wall of fire.
timeline.quote: spreading into a wall of fire that spanned the alley's width

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: The train stops amid an aether disruption that Chandra attributes to the renegade.
timeline.quote: A disruption. The aftermath of some kind of aerial display.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Years later, Pia has rallied a contingent of inventors and citizens as the renegades against the Consulate's grip on aether.
timeline.quote: Pia had rallied a growing contingent of inventors, tinkers, artists

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Pia rallies the renegades, listing grievances about the Consulate taking their aether, before the display.
timeline.quote: Let us be as proud, unafraid, unyielding as those who believe they can extinguish our spirits!

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: The thopters release a pulse of aether that topples the Consulate automatons.
timeline.quote: The sudden rush of energy flooded into the identical automata, creating sparks of concentrated aether.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra charges the soldiers and burns a crowd of automatons.
timeline.quote: inundated a crowd of the machines with a generous bath of flames

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan orders the soldiers to isolate and contain the pyromancer with gearhulks.
timeline.quote: Isolate and contain. Gearhulks in the front line

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa's vines topple guards moving on Chandra.
timeline.quote: Several of them toppled, feet tangled in a hissing whirl of flowered vines

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: To protect Chandra, Pia announces herself as the renegade leader and surrenders to Consulate custody.
timeline.quote: My name is Pia Nalaar, leader of the renegades. I'm prepared to enter Consulate custody.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Soldiers manacle Pia and read out her crimes.
timeline.quote: you are hereby placed under the authority of the Consulate for the following crimes

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Pia kicks and bashes soldiers to draw Chandra's attention and stop her advance.
timeline.quote: You forgot assault!

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni admits he cannot say where the Consulate would hold a prisoner of Pia's standing.
timeline.quote: I don't know where the Consulate would take prisoners of Pia's standing.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: A Consulate prison enforcer tries to force a bathroom door to seize a wanted convict.
timeline.quote: A wanted convict is currently barricaded behind that door.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: A potted plant coils around the enforcer's leg and he falls dazed.
timeline.quote: The potted plant by the door is inexplicably wrapped around the enforcer's leg

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa carries the enforcer outside.
timeline.quote: easily hoists the man over her shoulders in a fireman's carry

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni finds an escaped aetherborn convict dying in the bathroom with one minute left.
timeline.quote: I've got about a minute left,

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni finds the dead aetherborn was jailed for petty theft and is enraged at the Consulate.
timeline.quote: They shouldn't have been sent to prison in the first place.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni considers hunting down the Consulate with essence draining but decides the time will come later.
timeline.quote: No. The time will come for that.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Adi Thandray's angel was made a priority confiscation from the Fair.
timeline.quote: Adi Thandray's angel is a Priority One confiscation from the Fair.

citation.text: Platinum Angel (Kaladesh Inventions, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A device was submitted anonymously and its maker must be found.
timeline.quote: This device was submitted to the Fair anonymously.

citation.text: Paradox Engine (Kaladesh Inventions, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Consulate engineers adapted sky-dock assisters into a defense system for the Aether Spire.
timeline.quote: we were able to convert sky-dock assisters into a defense system for the Aether Spire.

citation.text: Ensnaring Bridge (Kaladesh Inventions, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Under Tezzeret's order, citizens are told to surrender their inventions.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret bids you to surrender your inventions.

citation.text: Confiscation Coup (Kaladesh, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Centuries earlier, inventors of the eleven kingdoms negotiate peace after a bloody war; Ghirapur is founded on neutral ground and eleven inventors become the first Consulate.
timeline.quote: Eleven inventors - one of each kingdom - became the first Consulate .

citation.text: "Avishkar", section "Formation of the Consulate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Great Aether Boom begins as the Mending leaves massive quantities of raw aether available.
timeline.quote: Since the powers of the Planeswalkers were reduced, there were suddenly massive quantities of raw aether for the taking.

citation.text: "Avishkar", section "Great Aether Boom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Inventors' Fair, Tezzeret steals Rashmi's matter transporter to make a Planar Bridge, and Pia and Chandra Nalaar are arrested.
timeline.quote: The theft of Rashmi's prize-winning matter transporter by Tezzeret , who secretly repurposed it into a Planar Bridge

citation.text: "Avishkar", section "Inventors' Fair". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Consulate seizes the Fair's inventions under the pretext of safekeeping, outraging inventors.
timeline.quote: the Consulate seized the Fair's inventions under the pretext of “safekeeping,” prompting outrage among inventors.

citation.text: "Avishkar", section "Inventors' Fair". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The War of Eleven ends when the nobles' court inventors open communication and end the conflict, founding Ghirapur and the first Consulate.
timeline.quote: The eleven artificers made the contested land their nation

citation.text: "Consulate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Avaati Vya refines raw aether, the Consulate distributes it, leading to an inventors' renaissance.
timeline.quote: Their efforts led to a plane-wide inventors' renaissance

citation.text: "Consulate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Consulate bans fire magic, making pyromancy punishable by death.
timeline.quote: The Consulate banned fire magic and made pyromancy punishable with a death sentence

citation.text: "Consulate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After unknown magic users save Renegade Prime from execution, the Consulate takes all unapproved inventions into custody.
timeline.quote: the Consulate issued an ordinance to all citizens of Ghirapur

citation.text: "Consulate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Consulate demotes Baral from captain to lieutenant.
timeline.quote: the Consulate demoted him from captain to lieutenant

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Consulate holds the Inventors' Fair, a month-long exposition in Ghirapur drawing inventors and spectators, while quietly seeking to collect and license technologies.
timeline.quote: a grand, month-long exposition held in the thriving city of Ghirapur

citation.text: "Inventors' Fair". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Consulate decree reduces aether allocation to under-utilized neighborhoods during the Fairgrounds' construction, upsetting citizens and inciting revolutionary support.
timeline.quote: However, the reduction in aether upset the citizens and inventors of Kaladesh, inciting revolutionary support.

citation.text: "Inventors' Fair", section "Construction of the Fairgrounds and aether distribution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Renegades repeatedly disrupt the preparations for the Fair.
timeline.quote: preparations for the Fair became repeatedly disrupted by renegades.

citation.text: "Inventors' Fair", section "Crackdown on renegades". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pia is forced to surrender to Consulate custody despite Chandra, Liliana and Nissa opposing the reinforcements.
timeline.quote: Pia was forced to surrender to Consulate custody.

citation.text: "Inventors' Fair", section "Crackdown on renegades". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Consulate enforcers seize all the inventions submitted for judging 'for safekeeping' while the crowd flees.
timeline.quote: seized all the wondrous prizes submitted for judging

citation.text: "Inventors' Fair", section "The Consulate's confiscation of inventions". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oviya aids the Renegades in their attack on the Consulate's Spire.
timeline.quote: Oviya later aided the Renegades in their attack on the Consulate's Spire .

citation.text: "Oviya Pashiri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani finds Grandmother Pashiri's building surrounded by Consulate inspectors.
timeline.quote: Grandmother's building was surrounded.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani sneaks into her ransacked home and knocks two inspectors' heads together.
timeline.quote: His metal-shrouded hands caught and knocked their heads together.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani pins the supervisor to a wall and demands to know where Grandmother Pashiri is.
timeline.quote: Where is Grandmother Pashiri?

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: The supervisor says she is in custody, trapped as a renegade, and Ajani knocks him out, saying he no longer kills.
timeline.quote: I don't kill.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde says she came looking for Renegade Prime and fears the Consuls took them, and offers to take Ajani to a renegade safe house.
timeline.quote: I came here looking for Renegade Prime. She was overdue.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde explains the Dhund is a secret Consulate headquarters beneath Gonti's night market.
timeline.quote: The Dhund is a headquarters the Consuls built under and through Gonti's market.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Following the mechanical bird, Ajani enters the Dhund and knocks out a guard.
timeline.quote: He backhanded the guard into the wall and winced at the sudden scent of blood.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani vaults the rail, sheds Grandmother's cloak and gauntlets and attacks the guards at the poison chamber.
timeline.quote: They unclasped and fell away.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani swings for a guard's throat but reads his soul and decides he is just a man.
timeline.quote: Not a Planeswalker. Not a villain.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani smashes the guard's chestplate without killing him and sends the other fleeing.
timeline.quote: It smashed across the guard's chestplate, scattering twisted metal shards across the marble floor.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani lets the guard he struck go home, repeating that he does not kill anymore.
timeline.quote: Go home to your family,

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: The announcer declares Rashmi top prize winner of the Fair and prizewinning inventions are quietly taken by guards.
timeline.quote: An announcer was proclaiming that Rashmi had won top prize at the Fair

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Enforcer-Chief Ranaj's soldiers seize inventions across the fairgrounds, provoking panic and anger among the inventors.
timeline.quote: Enforcer-Chief Ranaj's soldiers were seizing inventions in their characteristically clumsy fashion

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan advises an enforcer how to disable a lifecraft elephant by cutting its exposed cable.
timeline.quote: All that is required is to sever the cable, and the entire automaton will collapse.

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan orders the elven lifecrafter taken into custody for the disturbance.
timeline.quote: Take the elf into custody to answer for this disturbance.

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan reaches the storage facility where scientists catalog the confiscated inventions, which he now oversees.
timeline.quote: Top scientists and inventors from every Consulate inquirium in the city had been sent here

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: The Consulate develops mass production and distribution of refined aether, with airships and pipelines.
timeline.quote: The Consulate developed methods for mass production and distribution of refined aether.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Plane-wide availability of aether spurs the Great Aether Boom, a time of frenzied invention.
timeline.quote: It was a time of frenzied invention, boundless hope, and wondrous celebration.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: The renegades come to defy the Consulate, believing it conceals information and oppresses the public.
timeline.quote: These renegades defy the Consulate as they attempt to restore the independence they believe they deserve.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: The Consulate announces the Inventors' Fair, to be held for a month across downtown Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: For a full month, the fairgrounds will span the whole of downtown Ghirapur, the largest city on Kaladesh.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch realize the showdown was Tezzeret's scheme: the Consulate confiscated all the Fair's inventions and Tezzeret locks himself away to build a device.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret's accomplices in the Consulate confiscated all the wondrous inventions at the Fair.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: A Consulate enforcer and an armament automaton arrest Nived for vandalism and shock him unconscious with an energy device.
timeline.quote: Nived screams, seizes, and topples to the ground.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni, descending the ladder, sees a Consulate cruiser speeding toward the statue and leaps onto its hood, draining the enforcer driver to death.
timeline.quote: And I jump down.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon confronts Liliana for killing Consulate forces; she argues death is a tool and they had to.
timeline.quote: "We don't kill."

citation.text: "Quiet Moments" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon withstands a charging Consulate charger in Bomat and shields its driver.
timeline.quote: The charger smashed into Gideon.

citation.text: "Quiet Moments" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Consulate forces arrive and Gideon readies to fight.
timeline.quote: "They're there! Stop them!"

citation.text: "Quiet Moments" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Kari and Jace use Jace's illusions to pose as a Consulate vessel and steal canisters of aether from a Consulate collecting ship.
timeline.quote: smuggling canisters of their inventory onto her ship under the approving gaze of Consulate stooges

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Depala dives the Dragon's Smile into the Consulate blockade, scattering the formation, and the raiders deploy.
timeline.quote: Dragon's Smile soared between the first of the Consulate ships and through the gap in the blockade.

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Kari fights Consulate enforcers on the deck and in flight.
timeline.quote: Kari and the dwarf tumbled to the deck of Dragon's Smile .

citation.text: "The Skies over Ghirapur" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Pia Nalaar mourns that the Consulate seized the inventors' workshops and creations.
timeline.quote: The workshops are silent. Our creations have been seized.

citation.text: Consulate Crackdown (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gideon wonders how the consuls can be blind to Tezzeret's manipulations.
timeline.quote: how can the consuls be so blind to Tezzeret's manipulations?

citation.text: Deft Dismissal (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Renegade forces closed in on the Aether Spire as Consulate blockades failed one by one.
timeline.quote: As renegade forces closed in on the Aether Spire, Consulate blockades failed one by one.

citation.text: Dispersal Technician (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Derby Crows joined the renegades in open revolt.
timeline.quote: were quick to join the renegades in open revolt

citation.text: Leave in the Dust (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Fighting spilled over into Giant's Walk, angering the normally placid giants.
timeline.quote: When fighting spilled over into Giant's Walk, the aether weapons and swooping airships angered the normally placid creatures.

citation.text: Enraged Giant (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Consulate turned devices from the Inventors' Fair into instruments of oppression.
timeline.quote: A few small changes transformed some of them from marvels of ingenuity to instruments of oppression.

citation.text: Pacification Array (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Surash says the wilds will abandon restraint as the Consulate has.
timeline.quote: If the Consulate has abandoned restraint, so too shall the wilds.

citation.text: Unbridled Growth (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Venkat Dasai rallies renegades to give the Consulate a taste of its own medicine.
timeline.quote: The Consulate sought to crush us. Let's give them a taste of their own medicine.

citation.text: Barricade Breaker (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Led by Pia Nalaar, the Renegades revolt and seize large parts of Ghirapur to overthrow the Consulate.
timeline.quote: the Renegades have seized control of large portions of Ghirapur

citation.text: "Aether Revolt", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Consulate responds with security, seizures of unregistered inventions, aether monitoring and a curfew.
timeline.quote: The Consulate responds with increased security and surveillance

citation.text: "Aether Revolt", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Grand Exhibition at the Inventors' Fair ends in stolen inventions, abducted inventors and violence, fracturing the Consulate and citizens and sparking revolt.
timeline.quote: inventions were stolen, inventors abducted, and violence threatened the crowds at the arena

citation.text: "Aether Revolt (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Consulate imposes martial law with automaton soldiers and a secret police, but defections grow.
timeline.quote: The Consulate saw no other option than to instate a state of martial law in Ghirapur

citation.text: "Aether Revolt (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Consulate declares martial law and militarizes Ghirapur while the Dhund hunts renegade networks.
timeline.quote: the Consulate declared martial law and transformed the city into a heavily militarized zone.

citation.text: "Avishkar", section "The Aether Revolt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The renegades attack the Aether Hub and begin a revolt; the Consulate diverts the Gatewatch with Baral and Dovin Baan and retakes the hub.
timeline.quote: the Consulate retook control of the Aether Hub

citation.text: "Consulate", section "Aether Revolt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Tezzeret's final defeat, the Consulate yields to the Renegades and Pia Nalaar is named consul of Allocation.
timeline.quote: Pia Nalaar was named as the new consul of Allocation.

citation.text: "Consulate", section "Aether Revolt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana stuns the Consulate soldiers at a barricade without killing them and enters the Spire.
timeline.quote: just enough mana to suck the breath from their lungs until their vision went black and their knees buckled

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: The reformed Consulate empties and demolishes the Dhund, freeing hundreds of prisoners, mostly mages and renegades.
timeline.quote: Hundreds of prisoners—most of them mages and renegades who had "disappeared" long ago—were released in the space of a couple hours.

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: Ghirapur celebrates a new Consulate leadership that includes Pia Nalaar.
timeline.quote: One that included even "Renegade Prime" herself, Pia Nalaar.

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: The Consulate recruits pilots from the League of Aeronauts, many of whom command fleets.
timeline.quote: The Consulate recruits its best pilots from the League of Aeronauts. Many go on to command entire fleets.

citation.text: Aeronaut Admiral (Neon Dynasty Commander, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The new Consulate overlooks Baral's past offenses because of his defense of Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: the new Consulate chose to overlook Baral’s prior offenses and transgressions

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Indigo Revolution removes the Consulate from power in a nearly bloodless revolution and installs the Avishkar Assembly.
timeline.quote: The Consulate was removed from power in a nearly bloodless revolution

citation.text: "Avishkar", section "The Indigo Revolution and Avishkar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

era.label: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

timeline.summary: The new Consulate forgives all of Baral's previous transgressions.
timeline.quote: the new Consulate forgave all of Baral's previous transgressions

citation.text: "Consulate", section "Rebuilding and the Indigo Revolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

era.label: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

timeline.summary: The Indigo Revolution removes the Consulate; the Avishkar Assembly is installed and renames the plane Avishkar.
timeline.quote: the Consulate was removed from power in the Indigo Revolution

citation.text: "Consulate", section "Rebuilding and the Indigo Revolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ishikari presents her improvised net machine, built in defiance of the Consulate.
timeline.quote: Crafted from whatever she could get her hands on in defiance of the Consulate and good sense alike

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The Aether Rangers repurpose Consulate surveillance thopters to scout the track.
timeline.quote: The Aether Rangers repurposed thopters once used for Consulate surveillance so they could scout the track.

citation.text: Nimble Thopterist (Aetherdrift, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Indigo Revolution ousts the Consulate.
timeline.quote: The Indigo Revolution ousted the Consulate once and for all.

citation.text: Thornwood Falls (Aetherdrift, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Consulate spends great resources trying to shut down the race and imprison the NCC's leaders.
timeline.quote: The Consulate spent great resources attempting to shut down the race and imprison the NCC's leaders, and was successful for some years.

citation.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Ghirapur Sprint". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
